facts_checked: Checked 2026-10-24. ACS 'Tips for Getting a Mammogram' (rev. 2026-07-23): time of month when breasts less tender, avoid week before period; bring prior mammograms and reports if new facility; top and bottom; no deodorant, antiperspirant, powders, lotions or perfumes under arms or on breasts (white spots); no necklaces; tell technologist about implants, symptoms, pregnancy/breastfeeding, trouble standing; compression 10-15 s per view; tell technologist if it hurts. FDA Office of Women's Health mammogram fact sheet: no deodorant/perfume/lotion/powder; tell clinic about implants when booking. USPSTF 2024 (every 2 years, 40-74); ACS (yearly 45-54, option 40-44). Practice facts from amiweb main 4b71184: services-data.ts mammography (prep items, 15-20 min, female technologist, breast health questionnaire and gown from waist up, results to physician 48-72 h plus letter, screening self-referral for most, diagnostic needs order, covered in full by most plans from 40); prices.ts mammoScreening $199 (since Oct 23 2026); constants.ts phone and hours.
